meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 它会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels/、注册并安装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,然后向你要 Resend 凭据写入 .env,把你的邮箱注册为 owner 并发出第一封问候邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入邮件渠道,或用 Resend 收发邮件时触发;它也可能在 /setup 流程中被调用。

say.text: 用 Resend 给 NanoClaw 加一个邮件渠道
say.note: 它会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试。

say.text: 把我的邮箱设成 owner,再发一封问候邮件给我
say.note: 该地址会成为会话 key:resend:<你的邮箱>。

say.text: 构建并跑一下 resend-registration 测试
say.note: 测试变红说明导入或依赖漂移了。

howto.what_en: It copies the Resend email adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and runs the registration test, then collects your Resend credentials into .env and sends a hello email to your address.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to add an email channel to NanoClaw or to send and receive mail through Resend; it may also be invoked during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add an email channel to NanoClaw via Resend
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, installs deps and runs the test.

say_en.text: Wire my email as owner and send me a hello
say_en.note: Your address keys the conversation: resend:<address>.

say_en.text: Build and run the resend-registration test
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted.
